findings.message: Matches Everything. If no version in `versions` satisfies `range`, or `versions` is empty, `set` stays empty and `simplified` becomes `''`. Because `''` is shorter than any non-empty original range, the function returns it. In semver, an empty range string means `*` and matches every version. A range that matched nothing gets "simplified" into one that matches everything. Return the original `range`, or another non-matching range, when `set` is empty.

Input Mutation. `versions.sort(...)` sorts the caller's array in place. Any caller that passes an array it reuses later, such as a packument's version list, will find it silently reordered. Sort a copy instead, e.g. `[...versions].sort(...)`.
